The '''Spanish Premiere Two-Player Game rules booklet''' is a 20-page Spanish-language Decipher rules booklet made for an impending Spanish-language Star Wars CCG release that was later cancelled. The surviving copy is a printer proof: every page has crop marks and a production slug reading '''SP 2 PLRY BOOKLET 7/2/98'''.<ref name="fb-sergio">[https://www.facebook.com/groups/starwarsccg/permalink/10159018539903127/ SWCCG Two-Player Game Rulesbook (Spanish).pdf], Sergio Domenech, Star Wars CCG Facebook group (8 September 2021). Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/swccg-spanish-2pg-rules-booklet-1998 Internet Archive]; [[:File:Spanish_Premiere_Two-Player_Game_rules_booklet.pdf]].</ref> [[Sergio Domenech]] posted the scan to the Star Wars CCG Facebook group on 8 September 2021.

The cover is titled '''Juego introductorio para dos jugadores''' / '''Libro de reglas'''. Page 2 names the game '''''Guerra de las Galaxias: Juego de Cartas Coleccionables (SW-JCC)'''''. The booklet is the Spanish counterpart of the English [[Premiere Two-Player Introductory Game]] rules booklet.

The full scan is [[:File:Spanish_Premiere_Two-Player_Game_rules_booklet.pdf]] and [https://archive.org/details/swccg-spanish-2pg-rules-booklet-1998 Internet Archive]. Language editions of SWCCG are on [[Translations of SWCCG]].
